summaryDeep: Their moods, needs, and habits of comfort work smoothly with your judgment about what's possible. It runs easily and asks little, quietly steadying the rest of the bond. Lean on how naturally this one lines up.
tension: Because the support is gentle rather than overwhelming, it's easy to miss. You might assume they know what's going on without ever saying it. You might keep things to yourself until you're already struggling, then wonder why the connection doesn't feel as supportive as it could.
advice: The more you let this person be part of your emotional world, the stronger the bond becomes. The more honest you are about what's going on, the more room there is for real support. What starts as simple kindness can grow into something deeply comforting and reliable over time.
